Loss report: gitlab -> drone
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/release job.container: default image ubuntu:latest (the job names no image, so steps without one run in ubuntu:latest)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/release/step/script step.shell: bash-if-present wrapper command (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; Drone pipes commands to /bin/sh, so one command re-runs the script under bash -e when the image has bash, else under sh -e, and bash-only syntax fails under sh)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/0 trigger.filter.tags: doublestar glob; ref filter refs/tags/<pattern> (pattern v** has a different meaning in doublestar than in the source; it is written as is; the tag name filter is written as a ref filter on the tag event)
